definitions.explanation: The inside of a building or enclosed space. Used as a noun or as a modifier (屋内の) to describe things located or happening indoors.

examples.japanese: {屋内|おくない}で{遊|あそ}ぼう。
{雨|あめ}なので{屋内|おくない}プールに{行|い}った。
examples.english: Since it was raining, we went to the indoor pool.

examples.japanese: この{施設|しせつ}は{屋内|おくない}が{全面|ぜんめん}{禁煙|きんえん}になっている。
examples.english: This facility is entirely non-smoking indoors.

notes:
FORMS:
{屋|おく} (roof, building) + {内|ない} (inside)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {屋内|おくない}プール: indoor pool
- {屋内|おくない}{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}: indoor parking garage
- {屋内|おくない}{競技|きょうぎ}: indoor sports
- {屋内|おくない}{施設|しせつ}: indoor facility
- {屋内|おくない}{禁煙|きんえん}: no smoking indoors

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {屋内|おくない}: indoors (inside a building — formal)
- {屋外|おくがい}: outdoors (outside a building — the antonym)
- {室内|しつない}: inside a room (more specific)
- {中|なか}: inside (general, casual)

USAGE:
More formal than {中|なか} and specifically refers to being inside a building, not just any enclosed space. Common in signage, facility descriptions, and regulations.
